definitions.explanation: A baseball game in which a pitcher allows the opposing team no hits and no runs through the entire game. From English "no hit, no run"; a {和製英語|わせいえいご} coinage.

examples.japanese: ノーヒットノーランを{達成|たっせい}した。
9{回|かい}までノーヒットノーランが{続|つづ}いた。
examples.english: The no-hitter continued through the ninth inning.

examples.japanese: あの{投手|とうしゅ}はプロで{一度|いちど}もノーヒットノーランを{逃|のが}したことがない。
examples.english: That pitcher has never missed out on a no-hitter in his pro career.

notes:
A rare pitching achievement, usually announced with {達成|たっせい}する (to accomplish).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ノーヒットノーランを{達成|たっせい}する: to pitch a no-hitter
- ノーヒットノーラン{達成|たっせい}: no-hitter achievement
- {完全|かんぜん}{試合|じあい}: perfect game — an even rarer feat (no baserunners at all)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {完封|かんぷう}: shutout — allows no runs but may allow hits, so it is a weaker feat than a no-hitter
